title: Define Destructive Color Variables in CSS
description: Add new CSS variables for destructive (red) button colors in both light and dark themes within the global stylesheet.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the CSS variables in browser dev tools for both light and dark themes. Use a color contrast checker to verify accessibility compliance.

title: Extend Tailwind Theme with Destructive Colors
description: Update Tailwind CSS configuration to include the new destructive color variables for use in utility classes.
test_strategy: Check that Tailwind utility classes like `bg-destructive` and `text-destructive-foreground` generate the correct CSS. Use these classes in a test element and verify the rendered colors.

title: Add 'Destructive' Variant to Button Component
description: Implement a new 'destructive' variant in the Button component using the cva pattern, applying the new color classes.
details:
In `components/ui/button.tsx`, update the `cva` configuration to add a 'destructive' variant. Apply the Tailwind classes for background and text color using the new `destructive` and `destructive-foreground` theme keys. Ensure all button states (hover, focus, disabled) are styled appropriately and consistently with other variants. Example:

'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 focus:ring-destructive/50 disabled:bg-destructive/50'

Update the TypeScript interface to allow 'destructive' as a valid value for the `variant` prop.
test_strategy: Render the Button component with variant='destructive' and verify correct styles in all states (default, hover, focus, disabled). Use Storybook or a test page for visual validation.

title: Verify and Test Destructive Button Variant
description: Perform visual and accessibility testing to ensure the new destructive variant renders correctly and meets accessibility standards.
details: Test the Button component in the application and/or Storybook. Check the destructive variant in both light and dark modes, across all states (default, hover, focus, disabled). Use browser accessibility tools to verify color contrast. Confirm that existing button variants are unaffected.
test_strategy: Manual visual regression testing, color contrast analysis, and keyboard navigation checks. Optionally, add a component-level test to assert the correct classes are applied for the destructive variant.
